comparison.rule: The NCL manuscript matches the Waseda terminal variant at a second separated C locus after the earlier D86 match, and three readable prose totals match both holdings. This is a bounded textual correspondence between distinct physical holdings. Neither a direct copy edge nor independent descent is established. Preserve both terminal readings and keep same-field 少／微 carry and higher 日差 places open.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Shared terminal and D86 C readings do not establish independent stemmatic votes or copying direction.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Whether the NCL and Waseda copies share an exemplar or a later correction layer, and which layer supplied this NCL leaf.

next: Prioritize an authenticated same-field carry instruction or a fifth/sixth 日差 digit. Keep total and terminal C as separate evidence fields.
